everyday.title: The familiar favorites
everyday.summary: A top, a bottom, shoes. Give a good basic combination another day out.
everyday.tip: Choose comfortable pieces you already reach for. Change just one detail, then save what works.

layer.title: A layer of intention
layer.summary: A simple base, finished with a useful outer layer.
layer.tip: Keep the base easy to repeat. Choose the outer layer for your plans and the weather, then check the shape in a mirror.

balance.title: Let one shape lead
balance.summary: Try a fuller piece with a more defined one.
balance.tip: Choose one focal piece. Adjust a tuck, a hem or a sleeve, and see which proportions feel comfortable to you.

accent.title: A small note of color
accent.summary: A calm base with an optional brighter finishing detail.
accent.tip: Try a little color in a bag, scarf or belt. Repeat a shade you enjoy, without needing to buy a new piece.

dress.title: The easy two-piece start
dress.summary: A dress or jumpsuit and a pair of shoes; add a layer if you want.
dress.tip: Start with a full-length look you enjoy. Check the hem and shoes together, then adjust one detail or an outer layer.

tonal.title: Quiet colors, more depth
tonal.summary: Explore a similar color family with a little light-and-dark contrast.
tonal.tip: Compare the actual pieces in daylight. Similar color tags are only a starting point; texture and shade add interest.
